name: Shiranui Lila
source:
"I want to know... I need to know."

The caretaker of the storehouse where the Meri family's paintings are stored.
She is a somber, elderly woman who's often seen wearing a classic black dress and lives a quiet life by herself in the living quarters attached to the storehouse.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
